```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Load data
data = FileAttachment("data/kpi_dashboard.csv").csv({typed: true})

// Continent colors
COLORS = ({
  "Europe": "#1696d2",
  "Americas": "#ca5800",
  "Asia-Pacific": "#55b748",
  "Africa": "#ec008b"
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedCountries = Inputs.checkbox(
  [...new Set(filtered1.map(d => d.country_code))].sort(),
  {label: "Pays", value: [...new Set(filtered1.map(d => d.country_code))]}

viewof xMetric = Inputs.select(
  [
    {label: "% multi-hosts", value: "pct_multi"},
    {label: "Pression (L/1000 hab)", value: "listings_1000hab"},
    {label: "% logements entiers", value: "pct_entire"},
    {label: "% longterm (≥30 nuits)", value: "pct_longterm"},
    {label: "Disponibilité médiane (j)", value: "dispo_med"},
    {label: "Ratio listings/host", value: "ratio_lh"},

  {label: "Axe X (scatter)", format: d => d.label, value: {label: "% multi-hosts", value: "pct_multi"}}

viewof yMetric = Inputs.select(
  [
    {label: "Prix médian (EUR)", value: "prix_med"},
    {label: "Pression (L/1000 hab)", value: "listings_1000hab"},
    {label: "Écart interquartile prix", value: "prix_iqr"},
    {label: "Disponibilité médiane (j)", value: "dispo_med"},
    {label: "Avis médians", value: "reviews_med"},
  ],
  {label: "Axe Y (scatter)", format: d => d.label, value: {label: "Prix médian (EUR)", value: "prix_med"}}
)

viewof barMetric = Inputs.select(
  [
    {label: "Nombre de listings", value: "n_listings"},
    {label: "Pression (L/1000 hab)", value: "listings_1000hab"},
    {label: "Prix médian (EUR)", value: "prix_med"},
    {label: "% multi-hosts", value: "pct_multi"},
    {label: "% longterm", value: "pct_longterm"},
    {label: "Disponibilité médiane", value: "dispo_med"},
  ],
  {label: "Métrique (barres)", format: d => d.label, value: {label: "Nombre de listings", value: "n_listings"}}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Reactive filtering
filtered1 = data.filter(d => selectedContinents.includes(d.continent))
filtered = filtered1.filter(d => selectedCountries.includes(d.country_code))
```

**Source** : Inside Airbnb, juin 2025 · 64 villes, 30 pays

### {.tabset}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Scatter"

Plot.plot({
  width: 700,
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 60,
  marginBottom: 50,
  marginRight: 20,
  grid: true,
  x: {label: xMetric.label},
  y: {label: yMetric.label},
  r: {range: [4, 30]},
  color: {
    domain: Object.keys(COLORS),
    range: Object.values(COLORS),
    legend: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filtered, {
      x: xMetric.value,
      y: yMetric.value,
      r: "n_listings",
      fill: "continent",
      fillOpacity: 0.7,
      stroke: "white",
      strokeWidth: 0.5,
      tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.city_fr}\n${xMetric.label}: ${d[xMetric.value]}\n${yMetric.label}: ${d[yMetric.value]}\nListings: ${d.n_listings.toLocaleString()}`
    }),
    Plot.linearRegressionY(filtered, {
      x: xMetric.value,
      y: yMetric.value,
      stroke: "#ec008b",
      strokeDasharray: "5,5",
      strokeWidth: 1.5
    }),
    Plot.text(filtered, {
      x: xMetric.value,
      y: yMetric.value,
      text: d => d.n_listings > d3.quantile(filtered.map(d => d.n_listings), 0.75) ? d.city_fr : "",
      dy: -12,
      fontSize: 10,
      fill: "#333"
    })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
      y: "city_fr",

    Plot.text(barSorted, {
      x: barMetric.value,
      y: "city_fr",
      text: d => barMetric.value === "n_listings" ? d[barMetric.value].toLocaleString() : d[barMetric.value].toFixed(1),
      dx: 4,
      textAnchor: "start",
      fontSize: 10
    })
  ]
})
```

# Column {width=40%}

## Row

### Corrélation

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

corr = {
  const x = filtered.map(d => d[xMetric.value]);
  const y = filtered.map(d => d[yMetric.value]);
  const n = x.length;
  const mx = d3.mean(x), my = d3.mean(y);
  const num = d3.sum(x.map((xi, i) => (xi - mx) * (y[i] - my)));
  const den = Math.sqrt(d3.sum(x.map(xi => (xi - mx)**2)) * d3.sum(y.map(yi => (yi - my)**2)));
  return den === 0 ? 0 : num / den;
}

md`**Corrélation** (${xMetric.label} vs ${yMetric.label}) : **r = ${corr.toFixed(2)}**

${corr < -0.3 ? "↘️ Corrélation négative — les deux variables évoluent en sens inverse." :
  corr > 0.3 ? "↗️ Corrélation positive — les deux variables évoluent dans le même sens." :
  "↔️ Corrélation faible — pas de relation linéaire marquée."}

**${filtered.length} villes** sélectionnées sur ${data.length} · ${[...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.continent))].length} continents`
```
